subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Everyone laughed, and Nancy wanted to quit.”?
options: The school required black shoes, but Leo's family could not buy a new pair right away.
Grandpa always kept an old pair of running shoes by the door.
Each pair of shoes had a note: "A student should be able to walk here safely."
That evening, her grandmother gave her a pair of plain black shoes.
